watchlist_posts_7d.name: Celebrate Woman
watchlist_posts_7d.text: Not every great gift is glamorous. A gentle electric #toothbrush says “I want you to feel good every single day.” Perfect for the woman 40+ who takes care of everyone else first. #giftsforher #holidayseason #gifts

watchlist_posts_7d.name: Celebrate Woman
watchlist_posts_7d.text: Daily sunscreen is the step most of us skip and the one that protects the skin you are working so hard to support. Make it a habit this fall. #MenopauseSkin #Sunscreen

drafts_today.text: Women 40+: if they discontinued your moisturizer tomorrow, which one would you panic about? Mine is my RIMAN night cream. Tell me yours, I want to know what's actually working this winter. #DrySkin #MenopauseSkin
drafts_today.video_tip: 10 seconds: hold your night cream jar up to the camera, on-screen text "If they discontinued it, I'd panic." End on "Comment yours".

drafts_today.text: November is National Healthy Skin Month. My challenge for women 40+: the same three products every night for seven nights, nothing new added. Healthy skin likes boring. Who's in? #NationalHealthySkinMonth #SkinBarrier
drafts_today.video_tip: 15 seconds: three RIMAN products lined up on the counter, then a paper calendar getting seven check marks in fast cuts.

drafts_today.text: Gel or cream? Once the heat comes on, most skin over 40 wants the cream at night, even if a gel was perfect all summer. Your routine is allowed to change with the season. #DrySkin #MenopauseSkin
drafts_today.video_tip: 8 seconds: swatch a gel and a cream side by side on the back of your hand, then text "Summer: gel. Winter nights: cream."
